requestedLayout: 4 columns by 4 rows; base directional, walking, battle-ready, attack, cast and knockout poses
review: Sixteen separated complete characters with strong and consistent Farquaad identity, square jaw, shaped bob, short body and red court clothes. All four base directions and walking contacts/passes are represented. Battle-ready cell 12 faces right rather than requested left. Attack cell 13 polearm reaches slightly beyond the nominal cell boundary, so extraction must preserve its full connected silhouette. Raster is richer than the requested native32x32/12-color grid and requires central reduction and quantization. Not yet cartridge-ready.
